title: Half a century of integrated hygienic processing
summary: Hygiene has been a central focus in poultry processing for more than fifty years. In essence, the underlying principles have not changed fundamentally. Hygiene is not about incidental cleaning or washing at isolated points; it requires a structural, integrated strategy applied consistently throughout the entire process. At JBT Marel, this thinking has always been embedded in the way poultry processing equipment is designed, processes are engineered, and production lines are built.
body_markdown:
#### AI and hygiene


In more recent years, hygienic processing has evolved further with the introduction of process intelligence. It is now possible to check each operation precisely, supported by AI-based learning. It becomes clear in real time if a process step is done correctly and hygienically. For example, the[VC-i](https://jbtmarel.com/en/products/vc-i/) can check if a drilled cloaca hangs correctly over the back of the carcass.


When performance drops below a hygienic threshold, action can be taken. Computer displays highlight the nature and location of the issue, and operators can intervene quickly to restore the hygienic processing.
